headline: Jio's record IPO closes bidding as oil near $114 and AI-spending fears rattle markets, while a PHP flaw and eMudhra's certificate fiasco hit tech.

stories.title: Cyclonic storm likely by Oct 26; heavy rain for coastal Andhra from Oct 27
stories.summary: IMD forecasts a cyclonic storm by October 26, moving toward the north Andhra Pradesh and south Odisha coasts. Heavy rain is expected in coastal Andhra from October 27.
stories.why_it_matters: Directly affects Andhra Pradesh, where you have roots.

stories.title: AP SEC extends nomination window for Kadapa, Rajampet, Mydukur, Tirupati after SC order
stories.summary: After the Supreme Court's intervention, nominations can be filed on October 23 and 24, 11 am to 3 pm, at designated locations and Collectorates. The court had asked the State Election Commission to decide where candidates could not file nominations.
stories.why_it_matters: Key Andhra Pradesh civic poll development with court oversight.

stories.title: PHP flaws trigger emergency response in India
stories.summary: Two critical PHP vulnerabilities led India to activate emergency measures. Banks are auditing apps, and government sites are being patched, with some taken offline. Razorpay warned merchants.
stories.why_it_matters: Hits fintech and backend systems directly.

stories.title: Tirupati MP alleges NDA 'coercion' against YSRCP nominees
stories.summary: The Tirupati MP has sought action from the State Election Commission over alleged coercion of YSRCP nominees.
stories.why_it_matters: Adds to the political contest around Andhra's civic polls.

stories.title: AP counter-intelligence busts Pakistan-linked honey-trap racket targeting naval data
stories.summary: Andhra Pradesh's Counter Intelligence Cell busted a digital honey-trap racket, including Indian conduits, aimed at leaking defence and naval intelligence to Pakistan's ISI.
stories.why_it_matters: A national security case originating from your home state.

stories.title: Telangana to host Raksha Expo from December 7
stories.summary: The three-day aerospace, space, defence and internal security expo will coincide with the Invest Telangana Global Summit 2026 near Hyderabad.
stories.why_it_matters: Signals Telangana's push on defence and aerospace investment.

stories.title: Houthi-Saudi escalation; India probing yacht incident off Yemen
stories.summary: India is trying to establish facts about an incident apparently involving Indians on a yacht off Yemen. It comes as the Houthis and Saudi Arabia target each other's infrastructure.
stories.why_it_matters: The Gulf escalation is driving oil prices and affects Indians abroad.

stories.title: Powerful earthquake in Tibet kills 16
stories.summary: A powerful quake struck a mountainous, sparsely populated area of the Tibet Autonomous Region, with reports of 16 deaths.
stories.why_it_matters: Major natural disaster in the region.

stories.title: Trump says Musk restored Ukraine's Starlink access
stories.summary: Trump said Musk restored access to Ukraine's Starlink network, which Ukraine relies on for military uses. Musk has repeatedly denied restricting access.
stories.why_it_matters: Affects the Ukraine war's military communications.

stories.title: BBC: Sudan's RSF deliberately targeted hospitals
stories.summary: A BBC investigation found hospitals were deliberately targeted by RSF fighters. The UN rights chief says the attacks may amount to war crimes.
stories.why_it_matters: Serious humanitarian and war-crimes findings.

stories.title: Meta hit with $25B fine in New Mexico
stories.summary: Meta was fined $25B after New Mexico declined to join a multistate settlement. Meta will appeal.
stories.why_it_matters: A record penalty for a big tech giant.

stories.title: India presses for UNSC reform
stories.summary: India's UN envoy said an organisation unable to renew its principal organ will struggle to command authority in a world far beyond 1945.
stories.why_it_matters: Reflects India's stance on global governance.

stories.title: Brent at $114 as attacks on Saudi Arabia intensify
stories.summary: Brent is headed for a third weekly gain as attacks on Saudi Arabia raise fears of wider supply disruption. Oil marketing company shares slid up to 2%.
stories.why_it_matters: Oil is the main macro risk for India's inflation and markets.

stories.title: Sensex falls over 1,000 pts from day's high; Nifty below 22,500
stories.summary: Indian equities deepened losses as oil prices soared, and broader markets also fell.
stories.why_it_matters: Context for your SIP portfolio's near-term swings.

stories.title: AI fears push global credit spreads to 17-month high
stories.summary: An AI stock selloff and geopolitical tensions have produced the biggest global bond-market risk-off signals in over a year. Al Jazeera notes the Nasdaq fell 2.6% amid AI-bubble debate.
stories.why_it_matters: Global risk-off feeds into Indian flows.

stories.title: Nifty IT jumps up to 3.3% on better Q2 results
stories.summary: IT stocks rallied after stronger September-quarter results eased worries about demand and AI disruption. Nifty IT is up 22% from its July low.
stories.why_it_matters: Your sector's health signals hiring sentiment.

stories.title: Swiggy hits 52-week low after Q2
stories.summary: Swiggy posted a ₹922 crore loss with revenue up 36% to ₹7,571 crore. Its adjusted EBITDA loss widened, and Jefferies, Nomura and Bernstein cut targets.
stories.why_it_matters: Bellwether for quick-commerce economics.

stories.title: Japan's core inflation tops 2% target
stories.summary: Japan's core inflation rose to 2.1% in September, above the BOJ target for the first time in nine months, strengthening the case for hikes.
stories.why_it_matters: BOJ policy shifts affect global liquidity.

stories.title: ICICI Bank revises service charges from Dec 1
stories.summary: Charges change for cash transactions beyond the free limit, demand drafts and ECS returns. Free limits are unchanged.
stories.why_it_matters: Practical personal-finance change.

stories.title: EPF earns interest for 3 years after retirement at 58
stories.summary: Interest continues until age 61, after which the account becomes inoperative.
stories.why_it_matters: Useful PF rule for planning.

stories.title: Shankar Sharma expects SIPs to disappoint
stories.summary: He warns heavy retail flows threaten macro stability and favours fixed income, gold and real estate. Separate data shows even 10-year small-cap SIPs had a worst case of -0.13%.
stories.why_it_matters: A contrarian view on your core strategy, with data for balance.

stories.title: Jio Platforms IPO final day
stories.summary: The ₹30,213 crore IPO closes October 23, priced ₹1,065–1,119, valuing Jio near ₹10.3 lakh crore. It was subscribed 5.57x by day 2, with retail at 1.54x. Allotment is October 26 and listing October 28.
stories.why_it_matters: India's largest IPO.

stories.title: Paras Healthcare IPO closes
stories.summary: The ₹1,450 crore IPO's final day sees a muted response, with retail fully subscribed and institutional demand subdued. Listing is on October 28.
stories.why_it_matters: Another IPO closing alongside Jio.

stories.title: Zetwerk lists at 5.3% premium, then slips to issue price
stories.summary: Shares opened at ₹159 versus the ₹151 issue price from a ₹5,012 crore IPO, then traded near the offer price.
stories.why_it_matters: Recent listing performance.

stories.title: Tonbo Imaging lists at 66% premium
stories.summary: The defence tech company listed at ₹1,162 on the BSE, a 66% premium to the IPO price.
stories.why_it_matters: A strong debut.

stories.title: OpenAI working on $30B raise at $1.25T valuation
stories.summary: OpenAI is reportedly preparing a new $30B round at a $1.25T valuation ahead of an IPO, which would make it the most valuable private company.
stories.why_it_matters: Shows the scale of the AI funding race.

stories.title: What FDE means at OpenAI
stories.summary: OpenAI published a piece on what forward deployed engineering means at the company.
stories.why_it_matters: Directly relevant to your FDE career target.

stories.title: OpenAI launches Decisions API
stories.summary: OpenAI is making its decision model widely available through a Decisions API for fast, low-cost decisions in apps.
stories.why_it_matters: New tooling for building AI products.

stories.title: Anthropic's Claude Duet app targets agents
stories.summary: Claude Duet is available via waitlist for Pro and Max users.
stories.why_it_matters: Signals Anthropic's agent push.

stories.title: Microsoft AI diagnostic tool beats doctors on hard cases
stories.summary: A Science study says Microsoft's step-by-step AI diagnoser was more than twice as accurate as general physicians on complex cases. TechCrunch notes most gains seem to come from the underlying models.
stories.why_it_matters: Notable AI capability claim, with caveats.

stories.title: Anthropic: LLMs make formal verification feasible at scale
stories.summary: Anthropic research argues LLMs make formal software verification feasible at much larger scale. It drew 240 points on Hacker News.
stories.why_it_matters: Could change how critical software is built.

stories.title: China-aligned hackers used AI agents to breach ConnectWise customers
stories.summary: Microsoft blames a China-aligned actor that used AI agents to rapidly hack into thousands of ConnectWise customers.
stories.why_it_matters: AI-driven attacks scaling up.

stories.title: Uber puts all 30,000 employees on ChatGPT Work
stories.summary: Uber is expanding from a small pilot to a company-wide rollout of the enterprise agent.
stories.why_it_matters: Enterprise agent adoption at scale.

stories.title: eMudhra exits global TLS certificate business after key incident
stories.summary: A flubbed key-signing ceremony compromised keys tied to eight intermediate CA certificates, and Google, Apple and Microsoft withdrew trust. The business is about 1% of revenue, its Indian signature services are unaffected, and shares are down about 40% in three sessions.
stories.why_it_matters: A major PKI failure involving an Indian firm.

stories.title: Anthropic builds its own source control system, Scion
stories.summary: Git struggled at 30,000 PRs per day, so Anthropic built Scion. The Pragmatic Engineer spoke to the team.
stories.why_it_matters: Insight into scaling engineering infrastructure.

stories.title: Netflix: single-tenant Titus with VM-level isolation
stories.summary: Netflix describes adding VM-level isolation to its Kubernetes-based multi-tenant container platform, Titus.
stories.why_it_matters: A good platform engineering write-up.

stories.title: Harvard study: AI code doesn't boost productivity due to bottlenecks
stories.summary: A study of 718 firms found AI assistants raise code volume but not completed work, partly because of added code review load.
stories.why_it_matters: Data on AI coding's real impact.

stories.title: Actors for Agents: patterns for production AI
stories.summary: A talk treats agents as distributed systems, covering state ownership, message passing and supervision boundaries.
stories.why_it_matters: Matches your distributed systems and agent interests.

stories.title: SpaceX and Tesla form committees to study merger
stories.summary: Musk said special committees are studying a merger of the two companies, though it is not certain.
stories.why_it_matters: A potentially huge tech consolidation.

stories.title: Comcast plans job cuts and more AI agents
stories.summary: Comcast is losing more customers and plans job cuts alongside deploying more AI agents.
stories.why_it_matters: Another AI-linked headcount signal.

stories.title: Ishan Kishan ruled out of second T20I vs New Zealand
stories.summary: Batting coach Sitanshu Kotak said Vaibhav Sooryavanshi comes into the calculations as replacement.
stories.why_it_matters: Squad change in the ongoing India series.

stories.title: Australia must change batting line-up after thrashing, says Cummins
stories.summary: After an innings defeat, Australia must consider changes for the deciding Test in Cape Town. South Africa's comeback win came despite losing two days to rain.
stories.why_it_matters: Sets up a decisive Test.
